title: Classify interest from the whole reply text, never a category or a snippet
hypothesis: The reply category and the 280-character snippet were enough to tell who was interested.
change: Fed the reply reader the whole reply text instead of the raw HTML's first 280 characters (65f7991d, 15b0384c).
result: 73 of 87 replies had been cut mid-sentence. With the whole reply, unreadable replies fell from 12 to 4, and two investor deck requests that sat two days unanswered surfaced.
next_decision: Classify and draft only from `text` in `gtm replies --json`, and run `gtme-reply intent` over every reply after any change.
check: Positive reply counts come from reply text read by a person or gtme-reply; a Clay category alone never counts as interest. `gtme-rules check-text` refuses client text claiming interest no reply quotes.
